question.stem:
Let \(P,Q\) be constants. If \(\frac{9x+3}{(x+7)(x-8)}\)

\[\begin{gathered}\equiv\frac P{x+7}\\+\frac Q{x-8}\end{gathered}\] find \(P,Q\).
question.stemZh:
設 \(P,Q\) 為常數。若 \(\frac{9x+3}{(x+7)(x-8)}\)

\[\begin{gathered}\equiv\frac P{x+7}\\+\frac Q{x-8}\end{gathered}\]，求 \(P,Q\)。
question.solution: Clear the common denominator on \(x\ne-7,8\) to get \[\begin{gathered}9x+3\\=P(x-8)+Q(x+7)\end{gathered}\] This polynomial identity extends to all \(x\). At \(x=-7\), \(-60=-15P\), so \(P=4\). At \(x=8\), \(75=15Q\), so \(Q=5\). Check: \(4(x-8)+5(x+7)=9x+3\).

question.stem:
Let \(A,B\) be constants. If \(\frac{3x+5}{(x+1)(2x+3)}\)

\[\begin{gathered}\equiv\frac A{x+1}\\+\frac B{2x+3}\end{gathered}\] find \(A,B\).
question.stemZh:
設 \(A,B\) 為常數。若 \(\frac{3x+5}{(x+1)(2x+3)}\)

\[\begin{gathered}\equiv\frac A{x+1}\\+\frac B{2x+3}\end{gathered}\]，求 \(A,B\)。
question.solution: Clearing denominators for \(x\ne-1,-\frac32\) gives the polynomial identity \[\begin{gathered}3x+5\\=A(2x+3)+B(x+1)\end{gathered}\] Set \(x=-1\) to get \(A=2\); set \(x=-\frac32\) to get \(B=-1\). Check: \(2(2x+3)-(x+1)=3x+5\).
question.solutionZh: 在 \(x\ne-1,-\frac32\) 下同乘分母得多項式恆等式 \[\begin{gathered}3x+5\\=A(2x+3)+B(x+1)\end{gathered}\]。代入 \(-1\) 得 \(A=2\)，代入 \(-\frac32\) 得 \(B=-1\)。檢查：\(2(2x+3)-(x+1)=3x+5\)。

question.stem:
Let \(f(x)=3x^3-19x^2+16x+24\).

(a) Find the remainder when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(3x+2\).

(b) Hence factorise \(3x^3-19x^2+16x+20\).

(c) Simplify \(\frac{3x^3-19x^2+16x+20}{9x^3-12x^2-12x}\).
question.solution:
(a) By the remainder theorem, the remainder is \(f(-\frac23)=4\).

(b) The expression is \(f(x)-4\), so it has factor \(3x+2\). Division gives \[\begin{gathered}x^2-7x+10\\=(x-2)(x-5)\end{gathered}\] Thus it factors as \((3x+2)(x-2)(x-5)\).

(c) The denominator is \(3x(3x+2)(x-2)\). Cancel common factors to obtain \((x-5)/(3x)\), retaining \(x\ne0,-\frac23,2\).
question.solutionZh:
(a) 由餘式定理，餘式為 \(f(-\frac23)=4\)。

(b) 該式為 \(f(x)-4\)，所以有因式 \(3x+2\)；相除得 \[\begin{gathered}x^2-7x+10\\=(x-2)(x-5)\end{gathered}\]，故分解為 \((3x+2)(x-2)(x-5)\)。

(c) 分母為 \(3x(3x+2)(x-2)\)，約去共同因式後得 \((x-5)/(3x)\)，保留 \(x\ne0,-\frac23,2\)。

question.stem:
Let \(f(x)=x^3-ax^2-2x+4b\) and \(g(x)=x^3-bx^2-5ax-18\), where \(a,b\) are constants.

When \(f(x)\) is divided by \(x+1\), the remainder is 20. Also \(g(x)\) is divisible by \(x+1\).

(a) Find \(a,b\). (b) Factorise \(f(x),g(x)\).

(c) Simplify \[\begin{gathered}\frac{f(x)}{g(x)}\\-\frac3{x-9}\end{gathered}\]
question.stemZh:
設 \(f(x)=x^3-ax^2-2x+4b\) 及 \(g(x)=x^3-bx^2-5ax-18\)，其中 \(a,b\) 為常數。

\(f(x)\) 被 \(x+1\) 除時餘式為20，而 \(g(x)\) 可被 \(x+1\) 整除。

(a) 求 \(a,b\)。(b) 因式分解 \(f(x),g(x)\)。

(c) 化簡 \[\begin{gathered}\frac{f(x)}{g(x)}\\-\frac3{x-9}\end{gathered}\]
question.solution:
(a) The conditions give \(1-a+4b=20\) and \(-19-b+5a=0\). Solving \(-a+4b=19\), \(5a-b=19\) gives \(a=5,b=6\).

(b) Substitute and factor: \(f(x)=(x+2)(x-3)(x-4)\); \(g(x)=(x+1)(x+2)(x-9)\).

(c) Cancel \(x+2\), retaining its original exclusion. The common numerator is \((x-3)(x-4)-3(x+1)\), which equals \[\begin{gathered}x^2-10x+9\\=(x-1)(x-9)\end{gathered}\] The result is \((x-1)/(x+1)\), with \(x\ne-1,-2,9\).
